aliases: 左边勾选条件的那种面板

description.zh: 集中承载筛选条件的面板，常驻列表侧边或以抽屉、浮层唤起：复选组、单选、滑杆组合出当前查询。 与列表实时联动刷新结果数，并支持已选条件回显与一键清除。
description.en: A panel concentrating filter controls beside the list (or revealed in a drawer or popover): checkbox groups, radios and sliders compose the current query. It syncs with the list to refresh result counts, echoes selected conditions and offers clear-all.

use_when.zh: 电商、检索结果等多维度数据浏览
后台列表需要组合条件定位记录
use_when.en: Admin lists locating records by combined conditions

use_when.zh: 需要展示各选项的结果数（facet count）

avoid_when.zh: 维度极少（1~2 个，用下拉或搜索框即可）
avoid_when.en: One or two dimensions — a select or search box suffices

avoid_when.zh: 筛选计算很慢（需要防抖与加载态）
avoid_when.en: Slow filtering — debounce and show a loading state

avoid_when.zh: 移动端直接堆砌（收进底部抽屉承载）
avoid_when.en: On mobile move it into a bottom drawer, do not stack it inline

note.en: Persistent left rail on desktop list pages

note.zh: 移动端以底部抽屉承载
note.en: Mobile hosts it in a bottom drawer

note.zh: 已选条件以可删除胶囊回显在列表上方
note.en: Selected conditions echo as removable chips above the list

notes.zh: 左筛选 + 右结果的双栏布局（lg 以下收进抽屉）。多选状态用 Set<string> 管理， 过滤结果用 useMemo 派生；面板顶部常驻结果数与「清除全部」；已选条件回显为可删胶囊。 选项旁标注 facet 数量帮助用户预估结果规模；重筛选时防抖并给列表 loading 态。
notes.en: Two-pane layout: filters left, results right (collapse into a drawer below lg). Manage multi-select with Set<string> and derive filtered results with useMemo; keep result count and clear-all pinned at the panel top; echo selections as removable chips. Annotate options with facet counts to set expectations; debounce and show a list loading state on re-filter.

basic.zh: 创建一个筛选面板（Filter Panel）：左侧分组复选条件，右侧商品列表，勾选后列表实时过滤并显示结果数。
basic.en: Create a Filter Panel: grouped checkboxes on the left, a product list on the right; checking a box filters the list live and updates the result count.

design.zh: 创建筛选面板。要求：分组标题 + 复选项（右侧带 facet 数量灰字）；面板顶部显示「共 N 个结果」 与「清除全部」按钮；已选条件以可删除胶囊回显在列表上方；选中项强调色标识； 移动端收进底部抽屉；深浅色主题一致。
design.en: Create a filter panel. Requirements: group labels and checkboxes (facet counts in grey at the right); panel top shows "N results" with a clear-all button; selected conditions echo as removable chips above the list; checked items marked with the accent; mobile folds into a bottom drawer; consistent light/dark themes.

implementation.zh: 用 React + Tailwind 实现 FilterPanel：selected: Set<string> 受控， filtered = useMemo(() => items.filter(...), [selected])；每组渲染 checkbox + facet 数量； 结果区显示 filtered.length 与空态（empty-state）；清除全部 selected.clear()； 胶囊回显 selected 项，点 × 移除；容器 lg:grid-cols-[200px_1fr]，小屏改抽屉； 防抖在数据源异步时处理。
implementation.en: React + Tailwind FilterPanel: selected: Set<string> controlled state, filtered = useMemo(() => items.filter(...), [selected]); each group renders checkboxes with facet counts; the results area shows filtered.length with an empty-state; clear-all empties the set; chips echo selections with an × to remove; container lg:grid-cols-[200px_1fr] collapsing to a drawer on small screens; debounce when the source is async.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现筛选面板（Filter Panel）。

先检查现有组件体系、路由参数与数据源，保持状态同步方式一致。
用途：检索结果页与后台列表。
要求：
- 分组复选 + facet 数量 + 实时过滤
- 结果数与「清除全部」常驻，已选条件胶囊回显
- 无结果时给出空态与清除入口
- URL 参数或状态可恢复，深浅色主题一致
- 不新增依赖
完成后运行现有检查，说明修改文件。
agent.en:
Implement a Filter Panel in the current project.

Inspect the existing component system, route params and data source first; keep the
state-sync approach consistent.
Usage: search results pages and admin lists.
Requirements:
- Grouped checkboxes + facet counts + live filtering
- Persistent result count and clear-all; selections echoed as chips
- An empty state with a clear entry when nothing matches
- Restorable from URL params or state; consistent light/dark themes
- No new dependencies
Run existing checks when done and list modified files.

task.zh: 组合筛选条件，再重置，观察结果数量如何变化。
task.en: Combine filters, reset them and watch the result count change.

checks.zh: 已应用条件与结果数量应一起更新。
checks.en: Update applied filters and result counts together.

checks.zh: 无匹配结果时，应提供清除或放宽条件的路径。
checks.en: Offer a way to clear or relax filters when nothing matches.
